text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
In celebration of Flower-chan's birthday! 
"Pamper Yourself Day" has officially 
begun! *drumroll* Ta-daaa~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-Is it really okay for me to ask so much 
of both of you today...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...Flower-san, you're always 
supporting everyone around you, aren't 
you? You're so attentive, just like a big 
sister to all of us.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep. Flower-chan helped me out when I 
got a nosebleed before, too. But, but, 
today's going to be different!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice and the others are... older sisters, 
after all. So today, we want to support 
you in return, kind Flower-san. ...What do 
you think?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm so, so happy...! Both hearing you say 
I'm like a big sister, and having both of 
your wonderful thoughts...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hooray~! Then right away, go ahead and ask 
the big sisters for it with a flourish!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Anything is fine, okay? Rice and the 
others will try our absolute best...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Umm, in that case... Could you help me 
look for my hat?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Your hats suit you both so well... I 
always thought they made you look so 
mature. So, I wanted to try wearing one 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Okey-dokey-dokey~! We're definitely, 
definitely, deee-finitely gonna find 
something that looks amazing on you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice will search with all her might, 
too...! We'll find that lovely hat, 
okay...!
